scope.review_type: human comparative adjudication of legal text, identifiers, dates, names, quantities, paragraph order and seal/signature noise
scope.gold_status: comparative QA complete; not a character-perfect publication transcription

Paddle preserves R.A. 170-178, article lists, dates and the substantive decisions; Tesseract loses or corrupts headings, article lists and date lines.
page_adjudication.risk: page 15 date line needs visual confirmation

page_adjudication.finding: Paddle preserves the administrative-law body and R.A. 179 / R.A. 109 references; Tesseract fast/best misread resolution references and legal vocabulary.
page_adjudication.risk: continuation/reference numbering must be checked against the scan

page_adjudication.finding: Paddle preserves R.A. 180-187, Acta 39/41/42, Arts. 64/94/105/117 and the law-project text; Tesseract confuses article 94 with 74/44 and damages titles.
page_adjudication.risk: page 28 has engine disagreement on the R.A. identifier; Paddle agrees with the page sequence

page_adjudication.finding: Paddle preserves R.A. 188-194, the Planetario decision, Actas 43/44 and the cultural-honours body better than Tesseract; Tesseract alters numbers, proper names and paragraph content.
page_adjudication.risk: page 30 GOTO 65 and pages 37-38 names/continuation require final visual check before publication

page_adjudication.finding: Paddle preserves R.A. 195-200, Arts. 64/88/94/105, Acta 45, the PROSOL decision and APROCA; Tesseract best changes article numbers and damages the operative sentences.
page_adjudication.risk: page 44 quotes and signatures need cleanup, not silent correction

human_verdict.preferred_pages: 44/44 for substantive legal text in this document
human_verdict.layout: Paddle retains order and paragraph grouping better, but all engines emit seal, stamp, header and signature noise.
human_verdict.runtime_tradeoff: Paddle is 4.86x slower than Tesseract fast and 4.86x slower than Tesseract best on this 44-page run.
human_verdict.decision: Paddle becomes the candidate engine for the next representative gold set. It is not promoted to production and does not overwrite historical OCR.

publication_blockers: independent character-perfect gold transcription and true CER/WER
visual confirmation of dates, numerals, instrument names and signatures flagged above
120-200 page representative benchmark before national reprocessing
page-level provenance for any candidate OCR output
